basic_info.description: This light-filled corner home blends comfort and convenience. The updated eat-in kitchen shines with all-new appliances (12/23), while a new water heater (6/25) adds peace of mind. Energy efficiency comes easy with owned solar, and the owned security camera system offers extra reassurance. The lower level provides three additional unwarranted rooms and a bathroom perfect for flexible use. Enjoy a central location just moments from the 3rd Street Light Rail, YMCA, and library.
